findings.note: ESPN's preview shows Toronto at 3.20 GF/G and 3.20 GA/G with a 28.6% power play, and Columbus allowing 3.29 GA/G with a 68.0% penalty kill. CBJ's Talbot is at .873 and Toronto's listed goalies are at .902 and .875, all of which leans toward more goals.

Toronto hosted San Jose on Mon Oct 19, so this is the second game of a back-to-back. A backup goalie is possible, but no confirmed starter for either team turned up, and Covers lists the Over at 5-0 in Toronto's last five third-games-in-four-days.
